title: The Ultimate Rick Roll
description: This resource pack replaces every texture in the game with rick roll
body: This resource pack replaces every texture in the game with rick roll even all the buttons. If you do not have a minecraft launcher that let's you change resouce packs without entering the game you cannot turn off the resource pack unless you use the WordFull version because every button is rick roll.  The WordFull version is is the same as the reguler version exept all the text is not rick roll.
